title: RPA Developer
description: A roadmap for robotic process automation with UiPath/Power Automate, process analysis, bots, selectors, queues, exception handling, and production support.

tree.name: RPA and Process Foundations
tree.description: Understand repetitive process automation, process discovery, rule-based workflows, ROI, bot suitability, and automation limits.

children.name: Process Mapping
children.description: Document current steps, systems, inputs, decisions, exceptions, volumes, SLAs, and automation risk.

children.name: Basic Programming and Data
children.description: Use variables, conditions, loops, tables, files, regex, email, APIs, and spreadsheet operations.

tree.name: Bot Development
tree.description: Build attended and unattended bots with UI automation, selectors, queues, credentials, documents, and reusable workflows.

children.name: UiPath Studio
children.description: Use activities, selectors, variables, arguments, data tables, REFramework, Orchestrator, and package publishing.

children.name: Power Automate
children.description: Create cloud flows, desktop flows, approvals, connectors, scheduled triggers, and Microsoft 365 automations.

children.name: Practice: Exception Handling Drill
children.description: Design a bot flow that handles missing data, app crashes, duplicate records, retries, and escalation.

tree.name: Reliability and Production Support
tree.description: Make bots resilient with exception handling, logging, queues, retries, test data, monitoring, and support runbooks.

children.name: Exception Handling and Queues
children.description: Handle business/system exceptions, retries, screenshots, queue transactions, deadlines, and escalation rules.

children.name: Testing and Monitoring
children.description: Create test cases, fake data, logs, dashboards, alerts, versioning, bot schedules, and rollback procedures.

tree.name: Governance and Portfolio
tree.description: Deliver automations with documentation, security reviews, ROI reports, business sign-off, and maintenance plans.

children.name: Security and Governance
children.description: Manage credentials, bot permissions, audit logs, PII, approvals, change requests, and automation ownership.

children.name: Project: Invoice Processing Bot
children.description: Build a bot that reads invoices, validates data, updates a spreadsheet/ERP mock, emails exceptions, and reports ROI.
